pythonFunction.name: validate_ssn_last4
pythonFunction.description:
Checks the last 4 digits of the customer's Social Security number against the account (only when
get_auth_options returned ssn_tax_flag SSN). The digits are never repeated back or logged.
Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    ssn_last4: The four digits, spoken, keyed or typed (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, result (Pass or Fail), attempts_remaining and agent_action; on Pass
    auth_status becomes Authenticated.
